description: Source code for xprepare.c, part of the LibXDiff library, implementing file differencing and classification functions.

classes.name: xdlclass_t
classes.description: Represents a classified record with linkage for hash chaining.

classes.name: xdlclassifier_t
classes.description: Holds classification data structures and parameters for record classification.

methods.name: xdl_init_classifier
methods.description: Initializes the classifier structure with hash tables and memory allocations.

methods.name: xdl_free_classifier
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the classifier.

methods.name: xdl_classify_record
methods.description: Classifies a record into the classifier, updating its classification info.

methods.name: xdl_free_ctx
methods.description: Frees context data for a file.

methods.name: xdl_prepare_ctx
methods.description: Prepares the context for a file, including reading and classifying records.

methods.name: xdl_free_env
methods.description: Frees environment data including both file contexts.

methods.name: xdl_clean_mmatch
methods.description: Determines if a line should be discarded based on neighboring line actions.

methods.name: xdl_cleanup_records
methods.description: Removes unmatchable or redundant records to optimize diff processing.

methods.name: xdl_trim_ends
methods.description: Trims matching records from the start and end of files to optimize diff.

methods.name: xdl_optimize_ctxs
methods.description: Performs trimming and cleanup on file contexts.

methods.name: xdl_prepare_env
methods.description: Prepares the environment for diffing two files, including classification and optimization.
